title: Frobenius Number — Three Generators (Foundation)
description: S2 ACT skeleton (researcher-1, 2026-05-13): foundation file for the three-generator Frobenius problem. Defines Representable3 a b c n := ∃ x y z, n = a*x + b*y + c*z and seven canonical closure lemmas (representable3_zero, representable3_a/b/c, representable3_add_a/b/c) by direct three-generator port of FrobeniusNumber.lean lines 42–69. All proofs are one-line ring/linarith. Foundation for subsequent stages targeting Roberts-1956 closed form g(n, n+1, n+2) = ⌊(n-2)/2⌋·n + (n-1) for three consecutive integers (S3–S5) and the Roberts 3-AP formula (S6+).

meta.author: Lean Genius
meta.assumptions: None at this stage. The file establishes the Representable3 predicate and seven closure lemmas via ring/linarith; subsequent stages will add frobeniusNumber3 (S3) and the main theorem (S5).
